presentation.speaker: imani_cole
presentation.title: Client switches agencies
lines: A major client is thinking of leaving. Let them go and refund the unused advance, or offer a discount to keep the campaign.

choices.label: Let them go and refund the advance
choices.detail: The campaign stops. The unused advance is refunded and your reputation takes a hit.
choices.outcome: The client left. The remaining media plan was cancelled and the unused advance refunded.

choices.label: Offer a retention discount
choices.detail: Pay $1,500 to keep the campaign running.
choices.outcome: The client stayed after the discount. The campaign carries on.
